m.e: Can you wake up to get to the car?

m.t: Tienes que despertarte ahora, chica.
m.e: You need to wake up now, kid.

m.t: A la niña le faltaba talento para la música.
m.e: The girl lacked musical ability.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7783120 by Eremon; English translation #267853 by CK

m.t: Luego cuando encontramos el cuerpo otra vez, faltaba.
m.e: Then when we found the body again, it was missing.

m.t: La única cosa que faltaba era su computadora.
m.e: The only thing gone was their computer.

m.t: De repente se dio cuenta de que le faltaba la cartera.
m.e: He suddenly noticed his wallet was missing.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #964325 by hundo; English translation #54160 by CK

m.t: Es como una pieza que faltaba en nuestras vidas.
m.e: Feels like a piece that's been missing from our lives.

m.t: ¿Cuál era el número que faltaba en la secuencia?
m.e: What was the last number left on that sequence?

m.t: Y contó alguna de la pólvora que faltaba.
m.e: And he reckons some of the powder was missing.

m.t: Para ser perfecta sólo le faltaba un defecto.
m.e: To be perfect she lacked just one defect.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2813 by Shishir; English translation #1636 by pyrachi

m.t: Siempre sentí que a este sitio le faltaba... un verdadero villano.
m.e: You know, I always felt this place was missing... a real villain.

m.t: Es la salsa secreta que nos faltaba.
m.e: It's the secret sauce that we've been missing.

m.t: Lo único que faltaba era un arco.
m.e: The only thing that was missing was a bow.

m.t: Lo que le faltaba de ingenio lo compensaba con energía.
m.e: What he lacked in wit, he made up for in energy.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2081202 by lazarus1907; English translation #301447 by CK

m.t: La pieza de la pipa que le faltaba.
m.e: The piece of the pipe you were missing.

m.t: Repentinamente notó que le faltaba su billetera.
m.e: He suddenly noticed his wallet was missing.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #541905 by Leono; English translation #54160 by CK

m.t: ¿Le faltaba parte de la pierna?
m.e: Was he missing part of his leg?

m.t: Tú eras la única que faltaba.
m.e: You are the only thing missing.

m.t: Le faltaba una escena cuando murió.
m.e: She owed one scene on it when she died.

m.t: Al joven ingeniero le faltaba experiencia.
m.e: The young engineer was deficient in experience.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #977541 by Shishir; English translation #46806 by \N

m.t: Este tipo ha tenido la única cosa que realmente nos faltaba la última vez: un plan.
m.e: This guy has got the one thing we were severely lacking last time: an actual plan.

m.t: ¿Qué... qué faltaba en ese informe?
m.e: What wasn't in the report?

m.t: Claramente, le faltaba su familia.
m.e: - He was clearly missing his family.

m.t: Papá, ella le faltaba mucho.
m.e: Papa, she was missing you a lot.

m.t: Nos faltaba un jugador.
m.e: We were missing a player.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8326726 by arh; English translation #9947651 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: No faltaba ningún estudiante.
m.e: No students were absent.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #858266 by iriberri; English translation #238507 by CK

m.t: Es que algo faltaba.
m.e: - Well, something was missin'.

m.t: Sabía que faltaba dinero.
m.e: I knew there was money missing.

m.t: - Lo único que faltaba.
m.e: - The only thing it was missing.
